3.hint: optional supply; must be grounded for parasite power mode

hints: parasite power is not recommended above +100 °C; use an external VDD there
during temperature conversions and EEPROM copies the current can reach 1.5 mA – in parasite power the bus needs a strong pull-up (e.g. a MOSFET) for that time
a bus held low for more than 480 µs resets every device on it
